import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/training_1.csv"

# Read CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Join Source3_51_0 and Source3_51_1 on the "city" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY [Source3_51_0.city, Source3_51_1.driver_count, Source3_51_1.type]
# Aggregations: avg(Source3_51_0.fare), count(Source3_51_0.ride_id)
group_cols = ["city", "driver_count", "type"]
agg_dict = {
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "count"
}

df_grouped = df_joined.groupby(group_cols).agg(agg_dict).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema
df_grouped.rename(columns={
    "fare": "Average Fare",
    "ride_id": "Ride Count"
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema:
# 'city': string, 'driver_count': integer, 'type': string, 'Average Fare': float, 'Ride Count': integer
df_grouped["city"] = df_grouped["city"].astype(str)
df_grouped["driver_count"] = df_grouped["driver_count"].astype(int)
df_grouped["type"] = df_grouped["type"].astype(str)
df_grouped["Average Fare"] = df_grouped["Average Fare"].astype(float)
df_grouped["Ride Count"] = df_grouped["Ride Count"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city column (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float columns in target schema)
# Aggregate average fare and count of ride_id
result = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    Average_Fare=('fare', 'mean'),
    Ride_Count=('ride_id', 'count')
)

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result.rename(columns={'Average_Fare': 'Average Fare', 'Ride_Count': 'Ride Count'}, inplace=True)

# Write output to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_51/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
